# Gathering nodes / Sammelgebiete

`Gathering.lua` is generated by `tools/import_gathering.py`, checked against pinned **QuestieDB** Forever data (commit and SHA-256 in `SOURCES.json`).

**Bundled since 0.29:** only the item IDs of ores, stones and herbs and the object IDs of the gathering nodes with the classic node skill (listed in the importer). **Where the nodes stand is read at runtime from the QuestieDB addon**, a required dependency of CraftPilot (`## Dependencies: QuestieDB`; CurseForge installs it automatically). No positions or counts are redistributed.

At runtime CraftPilot asks QuestieDB which nodes drop an item (`objectDrops`), counts their spawns per zone and shows the zones with the most nodes. Zone names come from the game client.

**Licensing.** QuestieDB's data historically had no explicit license ("when in doubt, all rights reserved"); reading it from the installed addon avoids redistributing it. Item and object IDs and node skills are facts of the game.

**At import (QuestieDB v1.1.2, e1652ce):** 40 ores, stones and herbs.
